Front leg depth is inferred; no authored profile gait or full-body 3D reconstruction is asserted.
The final source also reuses the C2 foot path for seat preparation and follows the actual body-transfer weight. These short transitions were not inspected continuously.
The fixture exporter/render command has been prepared and typechecked only; it has not been run.
